Interpretive Conditions: § 3314(a)(3) routes work on energized electrical systems to §§ 2320.1-2320.9 and 2940-2945 and (a)(5) routes deenergizing of transmission lines to § 2940.14, so the (l) training duty does not reach that work; the Note to § 3314(a)(4) states that compliance with § 2940.13 is considered equivalent to complying with § 3314, so an electric power generation employer running a § 2940.13 energy control program satisfies the (l) training duty through that program.
Regulatory Change Summary: Employers must provide authorized employees with training on hazardous energy control procedures and on the hazards of cleaning, repairing, servicing, setting-up and adjusting prime movers, machinery and equipment; 3314(l)(4) requires the training be documented, and compliance with Section 2940.13 is treated as equivalent for electric power generation installations.
Interpretive Summary: Supports a tiered lockout/tagout assignment differentiated by exposure level, plus a review of the written energy control procedure the instruction conveys.
Source Change Context: Authorized employees shall be trained on hazardous energy control procedures and on the hazards related to performing activities required for cleaning, repairing, servicing, setting-up and adjusting prime movers, machinery and equipment.
